article.headline: Southern defeats Grambling 87-73
article.description: — AJ Barnes had 22 points in Southern's 87-73 win over Grambling on Saturday.
article.story: BATON ROUGE, La. -- — AJ Barnes had 22 points in Southern's 87-73 win over Grambling on Saturday. Barnes also had four steals for the Jaguars (13-14, 9-5 Southwestern Athletic Conference). Damariee Jones scored 15 points while shooting 6 of 8 from the field and 3 for 3 from the line. Terrance Dixon Jr. shot 4 of 5 from the field and 4 for 5 from the line to finish with 12 points. Antonio Munoz led the way for the Tigers (11-15, 5-8) with 19 points and four assists. Grambling got 17 points from Jamil Muttilib. Jimel Lane had 11 points and 10 rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
